manifest.configuration_1: Open Create Folders, browse to a project directory, review the preview and tick the packages you want, then confirm to create the folders.
manifest.description: Point it at a project directory and it works out which sub-projects live inside, then creates a matching sidebar folder for each one. The scan is read-only, so you see the whole list and tick what you want before anything is created. Sub-projects nest under their parent the way they do on disk, and anything you have already set up is shown but never created twice.
manifest.highlight_1: Scans read-only first, so nothing is created until you confirm a selection
manifest.highlight_2: Lists top-level packages as rows, with deeper finds behind one collapsed group you can select all or none of
manifest.highlight_3: Confident matches start ticked; weaker ones are offered for you to opt into
manifest.highlight_4: Shows the signals behind each match, so you can see why a directory was picked
manifest.highlight_5: Folders you already have are listed but skipped, never duplicated
manifest.highlight_6: Reports exactly what was created, skipped, and what failed and why
manifest.use_case_1: Turn a monorepo or a directory of sibling repositories into one sidebar folder per package, so per-package steering loads without hand-building the tree.
